prompt: What was the age difference between the inventor of Barbie and the inventor of Hot Wheels?
answer: Ruth Handler (inventor of Barbie) and Elliot Handler (creator of Hot Wheels) were born in the same year, 1916. Elliot was approximately **seven months older** than Ruth—not 10 years. The apparent 10-year difference comes from their ages at death: Elliot died at 95 in 2011, while Ruth died at 85 in 2002.
